observations.title: Hygiene derivation and local ledger enforcement
observations.description: Destination derivation domain-separates HKDF by index, uses the core stealth derivation, and wipes key-material copies and retained stream seeds in finally. Recovery checks the derived address. Ledger prevents reuse by another source unless the caller explicitly invokes acknowledged reuse; protocol/zero/own-source checks remain. Index uniqueness depends on recorded ledger state and is local to each HopAddressSource instance; source documentation requires persistence across restarts. No externally reachable violation was established.

observations.status: trust-boundary observation; unranked and not browser-reachable on searched refs
observations.title: Older hygiene log helpers rely on RPC filtering
observations.description: parseTransferLogs validates log shape but does not retain or check emitter, logIndex, or blockHash; transferLogs forwards token/range constraints to RPC without revalidating returned emitter/range. spentCheck adds each returned matching outflow without deduplicating it. These helpers therefore must not be substituted for the stronger chain-adapter payment proof. Exact helper-name searches of main and primary-candidate apps/web/src found no calls to addressFreeReceipt, sweepConfirmed, spentCheck, batchedRead or pickDecoys. Search is reachability evidence only, not file coverage or proof about aliases in every branch. No live behavior, exploitability or severity claimed.

observations.title: Payment URI validation is structural, with bounded exact amounts
observations.description: EIP-681 accepts native transfer or ERC-20 transfer only, rejects duplicate/unknown parameters and token-transfer value, and parses amounts exactly into positive uint256 values. Generic URIs are capped at 2,048 characters; invoice links at 22,200. Display text rejects control/bidi/default-ignorable/surrogate and non-NFC text. Invoice-link payload is explicitly unauthenticated and must be opened by invoice-schema; structural host validation is not signer authentication. Optional non-EVM parsers were read only because the static source closure includes them, without broadening the lean UI scope.

observations.title: Package integration notes lag current browser imports
observations.description: payment-uri DEVIATIONS.md line 3 says app parsers are unused, while candidate qrClassify.ts invokes parseInvoiceLink and parsePaymentUri. metadata-hardening README line 3 says it is not wired into apps/web, while relayerClient imports padBody and calls it for padded request bodies. Its README dependency text also says viem 2.57.7 while reviewed candidate manifest pins 2.57.19. Treat these as stale package notes, not a reason to claim all hardening menu features are live.
